lines: <wavy>Mmph...</wavy> let me sleep.
Come back when the sun is up.
Mmph... I was sleeping.
I already woke up once for you tonight.
You've bothered me <shake>enough</shake> for one night.
Again? I was sleeping again.
<shake>My bed!</shake> What is wrong with you?
That was my bed. I will remember this.
My bed! Why would you do that?
That was <shake>mean</shake>. I am telling someone.
That was mean. I am finding a grown-up.
You should not say things like that.
My liege... how could you?
But why? After all the trust we placed in you?
I will not raise a hand against you, my liege. Please do not make me regret that.
You are still our royalty, but this hurts.
If anyone else had done that, I would fight. For you, I can only ask why.
You know, you're not so bad to talk to.
It's good to speak with someone who <pulse>listens</pulse>.
Talking to you is better than I expected.
I should have known better than to speak with you.
<pulse>Careful.</pulse> Villages remember cruelty.
Speaking with you was a mistake.
You've asked enough questions for one day.
I have work to do. Ask something else.
That is enough questions for now.
Enough of that for now.
Try something else. My patience has limits.
Enough talking for now.
Hmph. Maybe don't quit your day job.
I have heard better from a door hinge.
That joke needed more <jump>work</jump> before release.
